remarks: Welcome to Kingswood, a sought-after luxury 55+ adult community; A limited number of residents may be under 55 - purchasers must be 21+, and occupants 18+. There is currently no age restriction being enforced - an excellent opportunity to own now!! This one-bedroom, one-bath condo is a fixer-upper, ideal for buyers looking to add value with sweat equity. Enjoy community amenities including a media and business center, great room with fireplace, fitness center, and shared outdoor patio with grill. Per HOA, owner occupancy is required for one year prior to renting. Monthly HOA includes all utilities-electric, heat, AC, water, and sewer -owner pays only internet and cable. Includes two storage units (#29 & #75) and one assigned parking space (#27). Move-in and move-out fees are $300 each. Property is being sold as-is and is subject to probate court approval. Schedule your showing today!
